title: QUIZ - 63
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Build a linear model for a quantity that grows or shrinks at a constant rate over time
questions.question: A population starts at 125 and grows by 28 each year (x = number of years). Write a model for the population P after x years.
questions.explanation: The starting amount is 125, and each year adds or subtracts 28, giving P = 125 + 28x.
questions.hint: Start with the initial value, then add (growth) or subtract (shrinkage) the rate times the number of time periods.

questions.learningObjective: Build a quadratic area model from a described relationship between length and width
questions.question: A rectangular garden's length is 8 meters more than its width x. Write a model for the garden's area A in terms of x.
questions.explanation: The width is x and the length is x + 8. Area = width \(\times\) length = x(x + 8).
questions.hint: Area equals width times length; express the length in terms of the width first.

questions.learningObjective: Build an algebraic model for total cost from a fixed fee and a per-unit rate
questions.question: A company charges a flat $71 setup fee plus $5 per unit (t). Write an algebraic model for the total cost C.
questions.explanation: The total cost is the per-unit rate times the number of units, plus the fixed fee: C = 5t + 71.
questions.hint: Multiply the rate by the variable quantity, then add any fixed (constant) cost.
